Thanks Steph — quick signal on what we can provide and the constraints: 

- Latest Type II: our current issued report covers the period 2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31. We can share a redacted PDF today (same as attachment listed).
- Bridge letter: we can draft a bridge that affirms there were no control exceptions observed between 2026-01-01 and 2026-08-31, and reference the scope of the original SOC 2. Note: a bridge is an attestation from Redwood, not a certified auditor report; some customers accept it as interim coverage.
- Interim attestation: if GreenLine requires more than a bridge, we can prepare an interim attestation signed by our Head of Security that includes a brief control matrix and a summary of any material changes since the last Type II.

Turnaround estimates:
- Draft bridge letter (internal review): 48 hours from request.
- Final signed bridge/attestation (after legal): up to 5 business days.
- Control matrix CSV (redacted): same-day.

I've attached the bridge-letter-template.docx and a redacted control-matrix.csv for procurement to review. If Elena's security team needs specific control IDs mapped to their SIG questions, we can prioritize that next (add ~3 business days).

Let me know if you want us to produce a DocuSign-ready bridge (we can) — if so I will prepare for signature routing to the security signee.

Marissa Cole
Head of Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
